item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 22/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon and upper-air disturbances will affect Guangdong in the next couple of days. Temperatures will fall further and it will be very cold and windy with a few rain patches over the region. Upper-air disturbances will continue to bring rainy weather to southern China in the latter part of this week. It will still be rather cool over the coastal areas.

Date/Month: 22/01 (Monday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with one or two rain patches. Becoming cold later.
Temp range: 10 - 19 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
